title: How Many Fresh Labels Is a Year Worth? Code, data indices and results
description: Code, frozen configurations, sample indices, model predictions and result files for the study "How Many Fresh Labels Is a Year Worth? Measuring the Exchange Rate between Label Recency and Label Quantity in Text Classification" (submitted to Algorithms). Original post texts are not redistributed; the scripts and indices rebuild the samples from the public sources. See README.md for the steps that reproduce every table and figure.
